mechanism: Positive unrestricted lower bound on an interior neighborhood propagates to each boundary point of a smaller arc; imported arc reflection theorem then yields extension. Local noncriticality follows from Hopf boundary lemma for -log|f|. Necessity uses boundary defining functions after conformality.
exact_claim: Unrestricted Phi_f(z)->1 at 1 iff extension across a circle arc containing 1 mapping the arc to the circle. Nonconstant disk self-map; no global injectivity, finite Blaschke, alpha=1 or whole-circle extension assertion.
